scripts.text: You are not an Eden group member. You are not qualified to access the bulletin board.
scripts.translation: 您不是樂園團成員，無權檢視任務公告板。

scripts.text:
^008800Wait a sec!!
You cannot receive any more items because you're carrying too many items. Please try again after you lighten up.^000000
scripts.translation:
^008800等一下！！
由於您攜帶的物品過多，無法再接收任何物品。請在減輕負重後重試。^000000

scripts.text: Mission bulletin board for Lv41~55 adventurers.

scripts.translation:
[任務公告板]
任務公告板。

scripts.text: ^000077Ok. Let's check the missions next time.^000000.

[Mission Board Memo]
Have you seen a red frog? It is called Thara Frog and it's very rare. We are trying to verify where it inhabits. So please hunt 20 Thara Frogs.
scripts.translation:
[任務板備忘錄]
你見過紅色的青蛙嗎？它叫塔拉蛙，非常稀有。我們正在調查它的棲息地，請打倒20只塔拉蛙。

scripts.text:
[Mission Board]
You have accepted the mission. For more details, please press 'alt + u' keys, you can get information from the Quest Window.
scripts.translation:
[任務公告板]
您已接受任務。按“Alt + U”可開啟任務視窗，檢視任務詳情。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
